purpose: Held-out evaluation set for the one-photo XHS Scene Director: scene-only (no inspiration photos), one starter style per fixture.

groups.xhs_aligned: Backgrounds already close to the XHS look (window-lit cafés, attractive storefronts, tiled façades, clean stairs, colour walls).
groups.ordinary: Everyday places where the photographer has to work with what is there (parking, corridors, stores, desks, sidewalks, platforms, kitchens).

splits.heldout: Final base vs adapter comparison only. Never used to change prompts, settings or criteria.
splits.dev: For prompt or setting iteration. Different photographers and locations from the held-out split.

source: Wikimedia Commons, Category:Images from Unsplash (CC0). Same source and licence policy as portrait_v1 and train_v1; no social-media scraping.
usage: Images are NOT committed. `photo-ai scene-eval fetch` downloads them into samples/scene_eval_v1/ and checks every file against the sha256 below. Private-album photos may be added later only as a new dataset version with per-photo owner consent (provenance.source = "private_album").
